kind: e5 P104 and CSR frontend compatibility
testSourceBasis: Cleanly merged/staged frontend inputs, independent of the four unresolved server SDK/SQL paths. Exact selected files, rather than the pre-merge HEAD alone, define the tested source.

finalMergeBridge.method: Compare retained SHA-256, Git blob and byte count for each of the 29 selected tested inputs against committed HEAD and current working bytes. No tests rerun.

reviewFindings: Independent saved-document checks are explicitly not semantic/scientific approval; semanticVerified is fixed false in the contract.
Finding decisions bind current server receipt and saved snapshot; current hard findings cannot be waived by disagreement, and CSR scientific review remains separately required.
Review mutations share synchronous locks, generation fences, current actor checks and explicit reload after uncertain outcomes.
Shared skill administration exposes tenant/project scope, not private user scope. Sourced rules use exact versions, explicit conflict/revocation actions and cannot silently lower mandatory approval.
Correction source text is omitted from ordinary method test/design payloads; stale skill target/session forms retire.
Administration verifies exact derivative payload bytes, hash/version and fresh current session before human attestation; the AnA handoff contains fixed intent and candidate/project references only.
CSR narrative polling applies received progress while later requests wait, preserves newer completion/errors over late older replies, and retires prior job readers.
limits: Mocked component/transport qualification with selected pins, not an exhaustive transitive dependency inventory. The selected frontend inputs are bridged to the completed merge; server SDK/SQL resolution and its runtime qualification remain separate. No live IQ/OQ, real model qualification, private-profile backend/RLS acceptance, agency delivery, browser acceptance or full P104 acceptance is claimed. No broad editor/Vault 313-test rerun, compiler or lint run was performed.
